name: Channel
description: A place people talk (forge 26d-3): a named channel anyone may join, a private one only its members see, or a direct conversation between two people. Made by channel.create or dm.open; its members are its nexusMember records

fields.name: Name
fields.description: What it is called, without the #; empty for a direct conversation

fields.name: Topic
fields.description: One line on what it is for

fields.name: Private
fields.description: Seen only by its members; fixed when it is made

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: Who made it, who archives it and whose additions to a private channel need no membership; the one who opened a direct conversation

fields.name: Archived
fields.description: Read-only: no one posts or joins
